difference_explanation: In Drop N, the script used lengths.index(max(lengths)), which in Python returns the FIRST index with the maximum value. When options tied for maximum length and the correct option was at a later index (index 1, 2, or 3), lengths.index() returned the earlier index (0), causing those 5 tied questions to be omitted from the 179 count. In Drop O, the script used lengths[correctOption] === max(lengths), which correctly identified all questions where the correct option has the maximum length, including ties.
